title: Euler Subtree Ranges
statement:
Flatten a rooted tree and support subtree additions and subtree sums. The root is node 1. A subtree includes its root.

Input
n q, n initial node values, n−1 undirected edges, then q operations. ADD u x adds x to every node in subtree u. SUM u queries the sum in subtree u.

Output
Print one answer per SUM.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. Initial values and x have absolute value at most 10⁶.
